BlazeEnchantment
An Enchantment that ignites a Fire on every tile its host tool's own effect touched, reusing the existing Fire item rather than a new burning mechanism.
BountyEnchantment
An Enchantment that forces an extra growth attempt on any Plant occupying a tile its host tool's own effect touched, by calling the Plant's own Plant.forceGrowth(edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location) directly.
Breakable
Capability interface for anything an Actor can break with a BreakingTool: a Ground (a rock), an Item (a geode) or anything added later (a treasure chest).
BreakableGround
Abstract base class for Ground that cannot be entered and must be broken to clear the way.
BreakableTile
Met by the tiles whose Ground exposes the Breakable capability.

An Action that allows an Actor to break a Breakable, provided they are carrying a BreakingTool.
BreakingTool
Capability interface for Items that can be used to break Breakable things.

The burn inflicted on an Actor by standing in Fire: a fixed amount of damage every turn, for a fixed number of turns.
BurrowingMole
A pest that burrows one or two tiles in a straight line, up, down, left or right.
BuyAction
An Action that allows an Actor to buy a Purchasable product from a Merchant, provided they have enough coins.
CampfireReaction
The reaction to cold weather: lights a Fire on tiles adjacent to the given Location, with more tiles catching alight the colder the temperature in the reading that triggered it.

Abstract base class for an Action that requires an Actor to be carrying a specific kind of tool able to act on a Ground that exposes a matching capability (see CapabilityToolAction.canUseOn(T, C)), at a stamina cost determined by the tool by default (see CapabilityToolAction.staminaCost(HasStaminaCost, Object)).

Capability interface for Ground that is capable of holding a charge.

A Chicken that wanders the farm and can be fed, producing Eggs.

Creates new Chickens named "Chicken".

A copper node.

Cow
A Cow that wanders the farm and can be fed, producing Milk.
